title: Certify and publish V4 Guards 1.2.1
goal: Certify the repaired installed onboarding source at the final release commit, build two reproducible self-contained assets, publish an immutable 1.2.1 release, and independently verify both downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: The release-prep PR changes documentation only and passes all base-owned required checks before merge.
Full Guardrails and native Linux-complete and Windows-full Certification pass at the same final main merge commit with matching source packageHash.
Two independent clean checkouts produce byte-identical linux-x64 and win-x64 archives, each with a matching SHA-256 sidecar and sole v4-guards-1.2.1 root.
Candidate/recovery certification passes before the annotated tag v4-guards-v1.2.1 and non-draft, non-prerelease Release are created with exactly four assets.
Freshly downloaded assets pass hash, installed CLI and Companion smoke, and verified-uninstall checks on Windows and isolated Linux; a records PR captures the evidence.
risks: Packaged documentation changes the source packageHash, so certification and assets must use the final merged commit.
A mismatched RID, archive, sidecar or tag target would make the immutable publication ambiguous.
decisions: The 1.2.1 matrix contains only self-contained linux-x64 and win-x64 ZIPs and their SHA-256 sidecars.
The release-prep PR contains no protected trust changes or version metadata edits.
The exact release commit and publication evidence are added in a later records PR to avoid a circular package hash.
validationCommands: full Guardrails and exact-commit V4 Certification
two-clean-checkout RID reproducibility and candidate/recovery certification
fresh-download Windows and isolated Linux install/run/uninstall
